Jo (Ops): Quick follow-up: we need final language for the status page and clear owners for postmortem action items. Who can take what and by when?
Ravi (SRE): I'll own the internal RCA and ticketize all remediation items. Draft RCA in 48h, final in 5 days. I'll also pull past incidents with similar autoscaling footprints.
Marta (Support): Support needs a 2-sentence customer FAQ + canned replies within 12h. Also need a short escalation snippet for enterprise customers requesting deeper info.
Theo (Legal): Public comms must avoid speculation. Confirm impact, restore time, and data exposure only. Private RCA can be shared under NDA/contract. I'll pre-approve templates.
Lena (Product): Proposed status copy: "Degraded text-generation performance from 03:05 to 03:38 UTC. Service restored. No customer data was exposed. We are investigating and will post a detailed update within 72 hours." Thoughts?
Jo (Ops): That looks good. Marta will prepare canned replies after Lena finalizes the one-paragraph external summary.
Marta (Support): ETA for canned replies: 12h once I get the approved paragraph. I'll include escalation text for enterprise customers and a note to route RCA requests to Support.
Ravi (SRE): I'll include SLO impact metrics (p95 latency, error spike) in the RCA and tag related incidents for recurrence analysis. If pattern confirmed, propose dedicated resilience work.
Theo (Legal): Approved wording. For private RCAs, require NDA or contract channel; Support should record all requests.
Jo (Ops): Action tracker in-thread:
- LENA: final external paragraph (due 6h).
- MARTA: canned replies + escalation snippet (due 12h).
- RAVI: internal RCA draft (due 48h) + ticketize actions (due 72h).
- THEO: legal review of packet template (due 24h).
We'll do a 20-min sync tomorrow 09:00 UTC to review owners and links to tickets. Keep updates here.
IncidentBot: Incident #2026-303 marked RESOLVED by oncall deploy.
